title: Evaluation as inverse image on the ringed sequence site
statement:
The vertical inclusion C→ℕ×C at n is continuous and cocontinuous for the sequence topology. Its inverse-image functor on sheaves has the canonical right Kan extension right adjoint. The induced module evaluation uses the actual identity structural ring map, is additive and exact, and preserves the stated small colimits. The strict-system/module equivalence is additive in both directions.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
  [EssentiallySmall.{w} C]
  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
  (B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}) (n : ℕ)
def systemSequenceEvaluationToposAdjunction :
    (Prod.sectR n C).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type w) J (coefficientSequenceTopology J) ⊣
      (Prod.sectR n C).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous (Type w) J
        (coefficientSequenceTopology J)
```

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21, ordinary evaluation left extension and the subsequence generalization; Stacks 03DA, 03DB, 06YT and 07D9

proof.text: The vertical-cover description proves continuity and cocontinuity. Comma categories for vertical evaluation have small models, giving the needed right Kan extension. Identify inverse image with sheaf composition by the standard site adjunction, and identify module evaluation with restriction along the identity ring map. Sectionwise module linearity and componentwise colimit and limit formulas establish additivity and exactness, including both equivalence functors.
